_about: Tiles for the 'I MADE ME WOKE' set. {NAME} and {PRONOUNS} are filled from the command line. 'selfie' tiles send [base, selfie] (or just the selfie) to gpt_image_2_6; 'gif' steps animate the tile's own still; 'shared' tiles are ready-made files reused for everyone unless --fresh. Measured on varg 2026-11-05.
identity_line: Image 2 is a real photo of the person: keep their face, facial features, skin tone, hair color and likeness exactly recognizable. No other changes.

tiles.base_prompt: A polished production-ready character reference sheet and turnaround board for a fictional character called "THE ALLY". The character is in their late twenties, androgynous, with a short teal undercut with dark roots, a silver septum ring, large round pink glasses, freckles, a black slogan T-shirt reading "THE FUTURE IS FEMALE" in white Helvetica Bold, a boxy denim jacket covered in enamel pins, wide-leg mom jeans, scuffed black combat boots and a canvas tote bag. Show full-body front view, 3/4 view, side profile and back view in a clean horizontal lineup, plus a large hero portrait, expression studies (earnest, outraged, smug, crying), close-ups of the pins and the tote, and a color palette with swatches. Labels: FRONT, 3/4 VIEW, SIDE VIEW, BACK VIEW, HERO PORTRAIT, EXPRESSIONS, DETAILS, COLOR PALETTE. Warm cream background, soft studio lighting, clean grid, thin brown borders, professional film pre-production character bible.

fresh.prompt: A looping animated GIF of a super woke house cat: a plump calico rescue cat with a smug, judging expression, sitting on a sunny indoor windowsill of a cozy city apartment. She wears a rainbow-striped bandana and a round brass collar tag engraved "they/them". Beside her on the sill: a canvas tote bag, a glass of white wine, a small potted pothos, and a stack of unread books; a second sleepy cat naps on the armchair in the background. Animation: she turns her head from the window to look straight at the camera, gives a long, very judgmental slow blink, flicks both ears, swishes her tail in a big arc, then turns back to the first pose so it loops. Photorealistic, soft warm window light, fixed camera, the only text is the tag "they/them".
